existing_group_assignments.rationale: Increase, Necrosis is the same process as the Necrosis / Necrotic Tissue events in that group, differing only in wording or specificity.
Induced Ang II accumulation describes increased angiotensin II, the same as the other members of that group.

new_groups.rationale: Both describe decreased motile cilia function or structure in airway epithelium, at different levels of specificity (beat frequency vs number/length).
Prolonged action potential duration at the cellular level and QT interval prolongation at the organ/ECG level describe the same repolarization delay at different scales.
